fields.label: Title
fields.default: Why I stopped writing research reports

fields.name: letter
fields.label: Letter
fields.default:
For six years I wrote forty-page research reports. They were thorough, well designed and almost nobody read them.

What did travel was a fifteen-second clip of a customer sighing at our checkout page. That clip changed more of the roadmap than all my reports combined.

Fieldnote exists so every team can work that way: keep the customer’s own words, share them in seconds, and let the evidence do the convincing.
